heading: Proof of cession of territory.
text: A notification in the official Gazette that any portion of British territory has [1][before the commencement of Part III of the Government of India Act, 1935 (26 Geo. 5, c. 2)] been ceded to any Native State, Prince or Ruler, shall be conclusive proof that a valid cession of such territory took place at the date mentioned in such notification.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.by_ref_raw: A.O. 1937, Part III of the Government of India Act 1935, came into force on the 1st April, 1937
amendment_history.footnote_text: Ins. by the A.O. 1937, Part III of the Government of India Act 1935, came into force on the 1st April, 1937.
